I am a Computer Science student passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, software development, and healthcare innovation. Our mission is to develop an intelligent health monitoring platform that helps astronauts track, understand, and respond to health changes during long-duration space missions.

We aim to explore AI-driven health analysis, real-time vital sign monitoring, health data visualization, and early identification of potential health risks in space.

details:
Cosmic Care — Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring

1. Project Overview

Cosmic Care is an interactive mobile application designed to support astronaut health awareness during long-duration space missions. It brings together simulated physiological monitoring, predictive analytics, crew health assessments, mission readiness evaluations, and research-based educational guidance.

Developed using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript, Cosmic Care demonstrates how integrated digital health tools could support safer and more informed space exploration.

2. How Cosmic Care Works

The application includes several interconnected features:

  • Crew Health Monitoring: Displays simulated physiological measurements for four astronauts, including heart rate, oxygen saturation, temperature, respiration, and sleep information.
  • Predictive Analytics: Visualizes simulated future health trends and potential risk indicators.
  • AI Care: Provides interactive, predefined educational responses and research-informed health guidance.
  • Mission Readiness: Summarizes crew health status, monitoring coverage, and simulated readiness indicators.
  • Mission Events and Reports: Organizes health-related events and generates illustrative mission health summaries.
  • Mission Intelligence: Presents educational information informed by NASA research about human health in space.

3. The Problem We Address

Long-duration spaceflight exposes astronauts to physiological and operational challenges, including microgravity-related changes, isolation, communication delays, and limited immediate medical assistance.

Monitoring multiple health indicators and interpreting their significance can become increasingly important during missions far from Earth.

Cosmic Care explores how a unified, easy-to-navigate mobile interface could help organize health information and make potential concerns easier to recognize.

4. Innovation and Creativity

Cosmic Care combines multiple health-support concepts within one mobile experience rather than treating physiological monitoring, forecasting, and mission readiness as separate activities.

Its interface emphasizes clear visualizations, simplified health summaries, and educational guidance that can be explored through intuitive navigation.

The prototype also demonstrates how simulated predictive insights can be presented alongside current health measurements to support proactive thinking about crew well-being.

5. Technology Used

  • React Native—Mobile application development
  • Expo—Development and device testing
  • TypeScript — Application logic and type safety
  • Expo Router—Screen navigation
  • GitHub — Source code management and project sharing
  • NASA Human Research Program resources—Space-health educational context

6. Impact and Future Development

Cosmic Care aims to demonstrate the potential value of accessible, integrated astronaut health-support software.

Future improvements could include integration with wearable medical sensors, validated predictive models, secure medical data storage, and offline decision-support capabilities.

The current version is a functional educational prototype using simulated data. Its forecasts, alerts, and readiness scores are illustrative and have not been clinically validated. It is not intended for medical diagnosis or operational spaceflight use.

Cosmic Care represents a step toward exploring how human-centered technology and health science could contribute to the future of astronaut well-being.
